name: Taipei Open
stakes: This week in Taipei offers Indian shuttlers a vital opportunity to build momentum and secure valuable ranking points as the season progresses.
summary:
India arrives at the Taipei Open, a Super 300 event, with a strong contingent looking to make their mark. Men's Doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, currently ranked world No. 4, lead the charge as the top seeds. Their consistent performance makes them strong contenders for the title.

In Women's Singles, PV Sindhu, also a top seed, will be keen to find her rhythm. Fresh off a triumphant Japan Open victory, where she silenced doubters, her recent early exit from the China Open Super 1000 highlights the need for greater consistency. Meanwhile, Lakshya Sen, now ranked 14th, is eager to string together a series of strong performances and climb back up the rankings.

The Indian challenge extends to Women's Doubles with the promising duo of Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand, and Mixed Doubles pair Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto, India's top-ranked mixed pair. Veteran HS Prannoy in Men's Singles and rising talent Malvika Bansod in Women's Singles will also be aiming for deep runs, as the draw for the main rounds remains TBD.
